summary: Russia launched a mass drone attack on Yagotyn in Kyiv region, striking food enterprises and killing civilians including two emergency service workers in a deliberate second strike. Concurrently, Russian Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones barraged multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, and Sarny. At Abu Dhabi negotiations, Russia rejected Ukraine's ceasefire proposal while the US reportedly proposed Ukraine cede Donbas to end the war.
key_points: Russian forces launched a mass drone attack on Yagotyn, Boryspil district, Kyiv region, hitting sugar and dairy plants, causing fires, civilian casualties, and killing two State Emergency Service employees in a deliberate second strike on responders (Source: @eRadarrua/130121).

Russia launched coordinated Geran-5 missile and Shahed drone attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv (multiple districts), Zhytomyr (2 missiles on city center), Vinnytsia, Sarny, Kherson, Volyn, Khmelnytskyi, and Poltava (Source: @mon1tor_ua).

Ukrainian air defense tracked numerous reactive UAVs crossing from Bryansk, Kursk, Belarus, and the Black Sea into Chernihiv, Sumy, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Kharkiv regions (Source: @kpszsu).

At Abu Dhabi negotiations, Russia rejected Ukraine's ceasefire proposal; Ukraine demands de-escalation, security guarantees, and a Zelensky-Putin meeting; the US reportedly proposes Ukraine leave Donbas, which Zelensky called impossible (Source: @UkraineNow).

Canada announced $6 billion CAD over 10 years for CSIS to counter Russian influence operations aimed at undermining Canadian support for Ukraine, including identifying and disrupting Russian spies and agents (Source: @DeepStateUA/23995).

The Netherlands is collaborating with Ukraine on joint air defense production; the Dutch defense minister stated existing supplies are insufficient and a global air defense deficit exists (Source: @DeepStateUA/23994).

Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka and Chervone according to updated battlefield maps; reactive UAV groups detected near Izium and Sharyivka in Kharkiv region (Source: @DeepStateUA/23993, @eRadarrua/130146).
Threat of ballistic missile launches (Iskander-M, S-300, Tsirkon) from Bryansk and Kursk regions was issued by Ukrainian monitoring (Source: @mon1tor_ua).

points: Russian forces launched a mass drone attack on Yagotyn, Boryspil district, Kyiv region on November 11, 2026, striking food enterprises including a sugar plant and dairy plant, causing大规模 fires, civilian casualties (dead and injured), damage to private homes, cars, and kindergartens, and a drone falling on a school football field. A deliberate second strike killed two State Emergency Service employees during firefighting operations (Source: @eRadarrua/130121).

Multiple Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones targeted Ukrainian cities throughout the period: Kyiv (Boryspil, Brovary, Vasylkiv, Bortnychi districts), Zhytomyr (2 missiles on city center), Vinnytsia, Sarny (multiple alerts), Kherson, Volyn (Kamian-Kashyrskyi), Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivskyi), and Poltava (Kremenchuk district) (Source: @mon1tor_ua).

Ukrainian air defense forces intercepted and tracked reactive UAVs crossing into Chernihiv, Sumy, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Kharkiv regions from Bryansk, Kursk, Belarus, and the Black Sea (Source: @kpszsu, @eRadarrua).

The Ukrainian diplomatic team led by Foreign Minister Sybiha at Abu Dhabi negotiations proposed de-escalation, a ceasefire, security guarantees, and a direct meeting between President Zelensky and Putin; Russia rejected the ceasefire proposal (Source: @UkraineNow).

Russia launched coordinated missile and drone barrages using Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones from multiple launch points across Chernihiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, and Rivne regions targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Sarny, Kherson, Volyn, Khmelnytskyi, Poltava, and Kirovohrad (Source: @mon1tor_ua).

Russia threatened ballistic missile launches of Iskander-M, S-300, and Tsirkon from Bryansk and Kursk regions, indicating preparation for potential escalation against Ukrainian infrastructure (Source: @mon1tor_ua).
Russian forces deployed reactive UAVs from Bryansk region into northern Chernihiv region and from Kursk region into Sumy region (Source: @eRadarrua/130139, @kpszsu/95247).
Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk region according to updated battlefield map data (Source: @DeepStateUA/23993).

Russia explicitly rejected Ukraine's ceasefire proposal at Abu Dhabi negotiations, with Medinsky stating Russia will only be satisfied when it wins and signs peace on Russian terms (Source: @UkraineNow).

Russian tactical aviation activity was observed in southeastern and eastern directions, with the General Staff warning of potential aviation strike weapons targeting front-line regions (Source: @kpszsu/95208).
A group of reactive UAVs crossed Kharkiv region via Izium heading west, with additional RBpLA detected near Izium (3 units) and Sharyivka (1 unit) (Source: @kpszsu/95263, @eRadarrua/130146).
Enemy forces advanced near Kostiantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk region according to updated battlefield map data (Source: @DeepStateUA/23993).
Reactive UAVs were launched from Bryansk region targeting northern Chernihiv region, and from Kirovohrad region toward Cherkasy region (Babanka) (Source: @kpszsu/95247, @kpszsu/95243).
A reactive UAV was detected in eastern Kirovohrad region heading toward Kompaniivka (Source: @kpszsu/95237).

Multiple reactive UAVs crossed from Bryansk region into Chernihiv region and from Kursk region into Sumy region, with Ukrainian air defense tracking and responding to these incursions (Source: @eRadarrua/130139).
Several reactive UAVs were detected in northern and central Chernihiv region heading toward Men, Nizhyn, and ultimately Kyiv region (Source: @kpszsu/95206).

Reactive UAVs were tracked near Slavutych, Olyshivka, and Mykhailo-Kotsiubynske in Chernihiv region, as well as RBpLA moving from Ovruch in Zhytomyr region toward Rivne region (Source: @eRadarrua/130147, @eRadarrua/130141, @eRadarrua/130145).
A high threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch from Bryansk region was announced by Ukrainian monitoring services (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78109).
Additional reactive UAVs were detected in northern Chernihiv region and in Zhytomyr region heading toward Korosten and Zviahel (Source: @kpszsu/95205, @kpszsu/95213, @kpszsu/95254).
Reactive UAVs launched from the Black Sea targeted southern Odesa region toward Kiliia, Izmail, and Vylkove (Source: @kpszsu/95231, @kpszsu/95214, @kpszsu/95252).
A reactive UAV from Mykolaiv region crossed into Odesa region heading toward Berezivka (Source: @kpszsu/95232).
A group of reactive UAVs was directed to Mykolaiv region from the south, with another reactive UAV in northern Mykolaiv region heading toward Vradiivka (Source: @kpszsu/95225, @kpszsu/95238).
A reactive UAV from Kirovohrad region crossed into Cherkasy region toward Babanka (Source: @kpszsu/95243).
Reactive UAV activity was also tracked in Vinnytsia region toward Lyzhyryn and in Khmelnytskyi region toward Shepetivka (Source: @kpszsu/95245, @eRadarrua/130130).
